--- title: "12 · Selection Pressure (πN-πS)" subtitle: "Per-gene selection pressure bar plots with FDR significance" description: | Computes per-gene mean Δ(πN−πS) pooled across all DPI timepoints, maps bar colour to limma FDR via viridis, overlays significance stars (∗∗∗ / ∗∗ / ∗), produces a stacked DPI panel comparing dpi3 vs dpi5, and exports publication-ready PNG + SVG figures. categories: [genomics, virology, selection, piN-piS, evolution] jupyter: python3 --- ## Overview | Item | Details | |------|---------| | **Input** | `delta_per_sample.csv` · `selection_gene_key.csv` (in `data/`) | | **Key packages** | `pandas`, `numpy`, `matplotlib`, `scipy` | | **Statistics** | Mean ± SEM · Limma BH FDR · Kruskal–Wallis BH FDR | | **Output** | `selection_pressure_bar.png/.svg` · `selection_pressure_stacked_dpi.png/.svg` | | **Download** | [template.qmd](template.qmd) | Edit `GENE_ORDER` if your pathogen uses a different gene / protein name ordering. The default palette maps `FDR ≥ 0.05` bars to grey; significant bars use the viridis colormap scaled from the minimum observed FDR to 0.05. [← Gallery](../../index.html){.btn .btn-outline-secondary} [Download .qmd](template.qmd){.btn .btn-primary} --- ## User Configuration ::: {#user-config .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} GENE_ORDER = ["nsp1", "nsp2", "nsp3", "nsp4", "capsid", "E3", "E2", "6K", "E1"] FDR_COLUMN = "limma_overall_bh_fdr" # or "kruskal_bh_fdr" FDR_ALPHA = 0.05 # significance threshold for colour/star FDR_STAR_THRESH = [0.001, 0.01, 0.05] # *** / ** / * DPI_PANEL_LABELS = ["dpi3", "dpi5"] OUTPUT_DIR = "outputs" DPI_EXPORT = 300 ``` ::: ## Setup ::: {#setup .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} import os import warnings import numpy as np import pandas as pd import matplotlib.pyplot as plt import matplotlib.ticker as mticker from scipy.stats import sem warnings.filterwarnings("ignore") # ── Publication matplotlib style ────────────────────────────────────────── plt.rcParams.update({ "font.family": "Arial", "font.size": 8, "axes.titlesize": 9, "axes.labelsize": 8, "xtick.labelsize": 7, "ytick.labelsize": 7, "legend.fontsize": 7, "figure.facecolor": "white", "axes.facecolor": "white", "axes.edgecolor": "black", "axes.linewidth": 0.8, "axes.grid": False, "grid.alpha": 0.0, "xtick.color": "black", "ytick.color": "black", "svg.fonttype": "none", }) os.makedirs(OUTPUT_DIR, exist_ok=True) print(f"Outputs will be saved to: {os.path.abspath(OUTPUT_DIR)}") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Outputs will be saved to: \Documents\GitHub_Repos\lab-bioinfo-templates\templates\13_selection-pressure\outputs ``` ::: ::: ## Load Data ::: {#cell-load-data .cell execution_count=3} ``` {.python .cell-code} delta_df = pd.read_csv("data/delta_per_sample.csv") gene_key = pd.read_csv("data/selection_gene_key.csv") print(f"Loaded delta_per_sample.csv — {len(delta_df)} rows, columns: {list(delta_df.columns)}") print(f"Loaded selection_gene_key.csv — {len(gene_key)} rows, columns: {list(gene_key.columns)}") # Ensure gene_key has the expected FDR column assert FDR_COLUMN in gene_key.columns, ( f"FDR column '{FDR_COLUMN}' not found in selection_gene_key.csv. " f"Available: {list(gene_key.columns)}" ) delta_df.head() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Loaded delta_per_sample.csv — 81 rows, columns: ['threshold', 'sample', 'dpi', 'product', 'piN', 'piS', 'delta_piN_minus_piS'] Loaded selection_gene_key.csv — 9 rows, columns: ['threshold', 'product', 'mean_delta', 'limma_overall_bh_fdr', 'kruskal_bh_fdr'] ``` ::: ::: {#load-data .cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=3} ```{=html}

``` ::: ::: ## Panel 1 — Mean Δ(πN−πS) per Gene (Pooled) ::: {#cell-panel1-calc .cell execution_count=5} ``` {.python .cell-code} summary_rows = [] for gene in GENE_ORDER: mask = delta_df["product"] == gene vals = delta_df.loc[mask, "delta_piN_minus_piS"] summary_rows.append({ "gene": gene, "mean_delta": vals.mean(), "sem": vals.sem(), "n": len(vals), }) pooled_df = pd.DataFrame(summary_rows) pooled_df = pooled_df.merge( gene_key[["product", FDR_COLUMN]].rename(columns={"product": "gene"}), on="gene", how="left" ) # Cap FDR at 0.99 for visualisation; clamp negative / NaN to 0.001 pooled_df[FDR_COLUMN] = pooled_df[FDR_COLUMN].clip(lower=0.0, upper=0.99).fillna(0.99) pooled_df ``` ::: {#panel1-calc .cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=5} ```{=html}

``` ::: ::: ::: {#cell-panel1-plot .cell fig-height='4' fig-width='7' execution_count=6} ``` {.python .cell-code} # ── Colour mapping: viridis for sig, grey for non-sig ───────────────────── cmap = plt.cm.viridis fdr_vals = pooled_df.loc[pooled_df[FDR_COLUMN] < FDR_ALPHA, FDR_COLUMN] vmin = fdr_vals.min() if len(fdr_vals) > 0 else 0.001 vmax = FDR_ALPHA def bar_color(fdr): if fdr < FDR_ALPHA: return cmap((fdr - vmin) / (vmax - vmin)) return "#aaaaaa" def star_label(fdr): if fdr < 0.001: return "***" if fdr < 0.01: return "**" if fdr < 0.05: return "*" return "" colors = [bar_color(f) for f in pooled_df[FDR_COLUMN]] stars = [star_label(f) for f in pooled_df[FDR_COLUMN]] fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 4)) x = np.arange(len(pooled_df)) bars = ax.bar(x, pooled_df["mean_delta"], yerr=pooled_df["sem"], color=colors, edgecolor="black", linewidth=0.5, capsize=3, error_kw={"linewidth": 0.8}) # ── Significance stars ──────────────────────────────────────────────────── for xi, (val, sem_val, star) in enumerate(zip( pooled_df["mean_delta"], pooled_df["sem"], stars )): if star: sign = 1 if val >= 0 else -1 offset = sem_val + np.ptp(pooled_df["mean_delta"]) * 0.04 ax.text(xi, val + sign * offset, star, ha="center", va="center", fontsize=10, fontweight="bold") # ── Decor ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── ax.axhline(0, color="black", linewidth=0.8) ax.set_xticks(x) ax.set_xticklabels(pooled_df["gene"], rotation=30, ha="right") ax.set_ylabel("Δ(πN − πS)") ax.set_title("Selection Pressure per Gene (pooled DPIs)", fontweight="bold") # ── Colour bar ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── sm = plt.cm.ScalarMappable(cmap=cmap, norm=plt.Normalize(vmin=vmin, vmax=vmax)) sm.set_array([]) cbar = fig.colorbar(sm, ax=ax, shrink=0.65, aspect=20, pad=0.02) cbar.set_label("limma BH FDR", fontsize=7) cbar.ax.tick_params(labelsize=6) fig.tight_layout() png_path = os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, "selection_pressure_bar.png") svg_path = os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, "selection_pressure_bar.svg") fig.savefig(png_path, dpi=DPI_EXPORT, bbox_inches="tight") fig.savefig(svg_path, format="svg", bbox_inches="tight") plt.show() print(f"Saved: {png_path}") print(f"Saved: {svg_path}") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display} ![](template_files/figure-html/panel1-plot-output-1.png){#panel1-plot width=989 height=593} ::: ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Saved: outputs\selection_pressure_bar.png Saved: outputs\selection_pressure_bar.svg ``` ::: ::: ## Panel 2 — Stacked DPI Subplots (dpi3 · dpi5) ::: {#cell-panel2-calc .cell execution_count=7} ``` {.python .cell-code} dpi_df = delta_df[delta_df["dpi"].isin(DPI_PANEL_LABELS)].copy() dpi_summary = [] for dpi in DPI_PANEL_LABELS: for gene in GENE_ORDER: mask = (dpi_df["dpi"] == dpi) & (dpi_df["product"] == gene) vals = dpi_df.loc[mask, "delta_piN_minus_piS"] if len(vals) > 0: dpi_summary.append({ "dpi": dpi, "gene": gene, "mean_delta": vals.mean(), "sem": vals.sem(), "n": len(vals), }) dpi_pooled = pd.DataFrame(dpi_summary) dpi_pooled = dpi_pooled.merge( gene_key[["product", FDR_COLUMN]].rename(columns={"product": "gene"}), on="gene", how="left" ) dpi_pooled[FDR_COLUMN] = dpi_pooled[FDR_COLUMN].clip(lower=0.0, upper=0.99).fillna(0.99) dpi_pooled.head() ``` ::: {#panel2-calc .cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=7} ```{=html}

4.5), sharey=True) for ax, dpi_label in zip(axes, DPI_PANEL_LABELS): sub = dpi_pooled[dpi_pooled["dpi"] == dpi_label].copy() sub = sub.set_index("gene").reindex(GENE_ORDER).reset_index() sub[FDR_COLUMN] = sub[FDR_COLUMN].fillna(0.99) # Recompute colours for this subplot's FDR range sub_fdr_vals = sub.loc[sub[FDR_COLUMN] < FDR_ALPHA, FDR_COLUMN] sub_vmin = sub_fdr_vals.min() if len(sub_fdr_vals) > 0 else 0.001 def _sub_bar_color(fdr): if fdr < FDR_ALPHA: return cmap((fdr - sub_vmin) / (vmax - sub_vmin)) return "#aaaaaa" sub_colors = [_sub_bar_color(f) for f in sub[FDR_COLUMN]] sub_stars = [star_label(f) for f in sub[FDR_COLUMN]] x = np.arange(len(sub)) ax.bar(x, sub["mean_delta"], yerr=sub["sem"], color=sub_colors, edgecolor="black", linewidth=0.5, capsize=3, error_kw={"linewidth": 0.8}) for xi, (val, sem_val, star) in enumerate(zip( sub["mean_delta"], sub["sem"], sub_stars )): if star: sign = 1 if val >= 0 else -1 offset = sem_val + np.ptp(pooled_df["mean_delta"]) * 0.05 ax.text(xi, val + sign * offset, star, ha="center", va="center", fontsize=10, fontweight="bold") ax.axhline(0, color="black", linewidth=0.8) ax.set_xticks(x) ax.set_xticklabels(sub["gene"].fillna(""), rotation=30, ha="right") ax.set_title(dpi_label.upper(), fontweight="bold") ax.set_ylabel("Δ(πN − πS)") fig.tight_layout() png_path = os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, "selection_pressure_stacked_dpi.png") svg_path = os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, "selection_pressure_stacked_dpi.svg") fig.savefig(png_path, dpi=DPI_EXPORT, bbox_inches="tight") fig.savefig(svg_path, format="svg", bbox_inches="tight") plt.show() print(f"Saved: {png_path}") print(f"Saved: {svg_path}") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display} outputs\selection_pressure_stacked_dpi.svg ``` ::: ::: ## Summary Table ::: {#cell-summary-table .cell execution_count=9} ``` {.python .cell-code} summary_out = pooled_df[["gene", "mean_delta", "sem", FDR_COLUMN]].copy() summary_out = summary_out.rename(columns={FDR_COLUMN: "limma_bh_fdr"}) summary_out["significance"] = [star_label(f) for f in summary_out["limma_bh_fdr"]] summary_out = summary_out.round(6) csv_path = os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, "selection_pressure_summary.csv") summary_out.to_csv(csv_path, index=False) print(f"Saved: {csv_path}") summary_out ``` ::: {.cell-output
